# Contribution rules of @rfamedina

These rules apply to the files owned by @rfamedina in
[CODEOWNERS](../CODEOWNERS). Where they differ from the default guidelines in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md), these rules take precedence;
everything else in that file still applies.

## Pull requests

Pull requests are accepted, including AI-generated ones. The PR must be well structured in granular commits following the style of the repository, avoiding 1000s-line commits. The PR description must be concise, clear and human-written.

The pull request goes through review before it can be merged. During this review, the changes may be reworked, so the merged code may differ from the code of the pull request.
